name: Dire Maul
summary: In Feralas, Dire Maul's broken halls and coliseums are divided among rival powers. Once called Eldre'Thalas, the ancient Highborne city guarded Queen Azshara's arcane secrets. Gordok ogres, invading satyrs, and withered elven caretakers now divide its crumbling plazas.

sections.title: Eldre'Thalas and the Great Sundering
sections.body: Eldre'Thalas sheltered Queen Azshara's favored sorcerers, the Shen'dralar. When the Well of Eternity collapsed in the Great Sundering, Prince Tortheldrin raised a magical barrier that saved the city. Cut off from their source of magic, the surviving Highborne trapped the colossal demon Immol'thar beneath their sanctum. For millennia, they drew on its fel essence to preserve their immortality and arcane power.

sections.title: A Divided Ruin
sections.body: Centuries of isolation and dwindling power drove Prince Tortheldrin mad. He purged most of his own citizens so a small cabal could monopolize the demon's remaining energy. Beyond their sanctuaries, other powers hold the ruins. Gordunni ogres control the Gordok Commons and stage brutal gladiatorial games in the arena. In the Warpwood Quarter, Alzzin the Wildshaper and his corrupt satyrs spread their rot.

faq.q: What was Dire Maul originally called?
faq.answer: Dire Maul was once Eldre'Thalas, an opulent night elf city built twelve thousand years ago by the Shen'dralar. They raised it to protect Queen Azshara's most precious arcane lore.

faq.q: Who lives in Dire Maul now?
aliases: what monsters are in dire maul
faq.answer: Hostile powers divide Dire Maul. Gordunni ogres control the northern commons under King Gordok, satyrs and corrupted treants infest the eastern gardens, and a reclusive remnant of Highborne sorcerers clings to survival in the western sanctuaries.

faq.q: How did the city survive the Sundering?
faq.answer: When the Great Sundering tore the continent apart, Prince Tortheldrin and his arcanists cast a massive protective spell. It shielded Eldre'Thalas from the devastation that submerged the surrounding empire.

faq.q: Why are the Highborne here using demonic energy?
aliases: why do shen'dralar drain a demon
faq.answer: After the Well of Eternity was destroyed, the Shen'dralar suffered severe arcane withdrawal. To preserve their power and immortality, they bound Immol'thar and siphoned the demon's essence to survive.

faq.q: What happens in the arena at Dire Maul?
faq.answer: Ogres and slavemasters use the open coliseum in the city center, known as the Maul, as a fighting pit. There they hold gladiatorial tournaments, blood sports, and challenges to the Gordok throne.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see Eldre'Thalas as a tragic monument to unchecked arcane hubris and the demonic compromises that broke the ancient Kaldorei Empire.
As a mage, you can find arcane treatises and secrets from before the Great Sundering in the ruined Shen'dralar libraries, guarded by the ghosts of master sorcerers.
